name: Chill Climber
tagline: Grades are temporary. Good vibes are forever.
flavorText: You're here for the session, not the scoreboard. You'll happily jump on whatever looks fun, cheer for everyone else's send, and leave the gym in a better mood than you arrived — no PB required.
villainLine: They can't enjoy a climb without knowing the number first. You genuinely don't get it.
partnerLine: You keep the session fun, they keep it motivated — you balance each other out more than either of you admits.
